'''Shonbla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Shonbla worked as an archaeologist during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and had a shop aboard [[Carrick Station]]. An expert in archaeology, Shonbla would lend his expertise to any passing archaeologist.

==Behind the scenes==
Shonbla appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an [[Archaeology/Legends|Archaeology]] crew skill trainer aboard [[Carrick Station]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
